title: Archival editor configuration
description: Per-object configuration for the archival editor, read from archival_editor.toml at the site root. Keys are object names from archival_objects.toml, except `shortcuts`, which is reserved.

shortcuts.description: the entries offered by the editor's shortcut button, each creating a draft in one list. Reserved: an object of this name cannot be configured here.

objectConfig.description: configuration for a list of objects: either a top-level object list, or a list of children at any depth below one

views.description: the views available for this list in the editor. The first view is used by default.

children.description: configuration for child lists of this object, keyed by child field name. Nests indefinitely.

name.description: the name of this view, shown to editors when switching views

primary.description: the field shown as this view's primary content

secondary.description: an optional field shown as this view's secondary content

tertiary.description: an optional field shown as this view's tertiary content

shortcutConfig.description: a shortcut offered by the editor's shortcut button: the list a new entry is created in, and what to call it

name.description: the label shown on this shortcut. Defaults to the last name in `path`.

path.description: the list an entry created here joins, written as dot separated names: an object name from archival_objects.toml, then that object's filename where the object is a list rather than a single file, then the child field names leading down to the list, with an index wherever the route passes through one.
